runtime_checks.name: liq_controller_native_task
detail:
High command calls for the liberation of a3i_lctrl_town Factory. Cleanse the site of infected so friendly forces can move in.

Complete the assignment by 14:48. If Russian forces take the location first, the assignment is cancelled without a penalty.

runtime_checks.name: etask_search_and_type
detail:
A powerful special infected, Screamer, has been reported in a3i_etask_site. Search the marked area and neutralize it.

Its accompanying special infected are other types. Only the reported target must be killed. The search area marks its reported location and does not track its movements. You have 60 minutes. Keep hunting if the settlement changes hands.
